caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular container with slightly curved handles on both sides, rendered in black ink on a beige background. Centered on the surface of the container is an illustration of a bird perched on a branch with leaves; the bird has a long, striped tail, and the branch has several rounded leaves and curling tendrils. Above the bird and branch, near the top center of the container, is a small inscription that reads “N.A. WHITE & SON UTICA, N.Y.” with a small triangular decorative mark underneath. The lines are clean and monochromatic, and all elements are drawn in a simple, linear style.
title: Crock
